conviction_note: The Q3 revenue print will very likely clear a bar sitting at the low end of the company's own guide (it beat the top of the Q2 guide by ~4%), but this name has sold its last two beats on the next-quarter guide, so the move turns on the Q4 guide. Evidence for that guide is split: iPhone 18 Pro China sell-through strong, the fourth 2026 subsidy tranche landed 30 Sep, against China smartphone shipments down 12-15% in Q3, Counterpoint expecting a weaker Q4 and the weakest Double 11 in years. Hence p_up 52 on a ~10% absolute move. impact_sum +0.8 and the scaled +0.4 agree in sign and are both small.
bar: Company guide for Q3 2026 total revenue is RMB6.34-6.44bn (+23.1% to +25.1% y/y), from the Q2 release of 2026-08-20 (https://www.webull.com.au/news-detail/15434147498599424; https://finviz.com/news/383970/atrenew-shares-fall-as-softer-q3-outlook-overshadows-second-quarter-earnings-beat). Consensus per the Earnings Whispers-sourced preview of 2026-11-11 is $944.0M revenue, at the LOW end of the USD-translated guide ($942-957M), cut from ~$969M, and EPS $0.10 (https://finviz.com/news/421323/atrenews-slower-guide-puts-margins-not-growth-at-center-of-third-quarter-test). A stale Benzinga figure of $976.9M / $0.11 predates the guide. So the bar is the company guide plus one estimate source that agrees with it. No Q4 guide or Q4 consensus was found, and the Q4 guide is what the stock trades on.
positioning_check: Short interest is low. Equibles (settlement around 2026-10-20) shows 1.9M shares short, 0.87% of float, 3.5 days to cover, down 804K shares (https://equibles.com/stocks/rere/short-interest). Older figures elsewhere put days to cover at 1-1.5. This is not a crowded short. There is no listed options market (baseline options.status no_options_market), so there is no skew and no implied move. Tape: spot $4.005, run-up -4.19% over 5 days and +1.65% over 20 days, 36.8% below the 52-week high, 20-day realised vol 55.8%. TrendSpider shows -12.6% over 30 days. AAII (2026-11-18) notes two analyst downgrades and no upgrades in the month to 2026-11-17, and a -1.6% intraday move on 11-18.

findings.finding: ATRenew has beaten the top of its own revenue guide: Q2 2026 revenue was RMB6.609bn (+32.4% y/y) against a guide of RMB6.24-6.34bn, about 4% above the top, and against a consensus of RMB6.37bn. The Q3 consensus ($944M) sits at the bottom of the Q3 guide of RMB6.34-6.44bn, so a repeat of the habit (around RMB6.55-6.65bn) is a roughly 3-4% revenue beat against the street.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This name has not paid for revenue beats. Q2 2026 beat revenue and EPS, and the shares fell (-4.8% premarket; -11.1% per a finviz headline tag) on the softer Q3 guide. Q1 2026 also beat, and Stock Track reported -6.67% at the open on the growth guide (https://www.itiger.com/news/1155373858), although a finviz tag lists Q1 as +11.56%. Q3 2025 rose 10.7% when the beat came with a raised full-year guide (https://simplywall.st/stocks/us/retail/nyse-rere/atrenew/news/atrenew-rere-is-up-107-after-strong-q3-earnings-and-upgraded).
findings.why_not_priced: The consensus was cut to the low end of the guide ($969M to $944M) rather than set at the company's habitual beat level. If the habit were priced, the consensus would sit near or above the top of the guide, and the stock would not have drifted 12.6% lower over 30 days into the print. Largely priced as a pattern, all the same: the market knows the company guides conservatively.
findings.independence: The Q2 company release (https://www.webull.com.au/news-detail/15434147498599424) confirms the beat of the top of the guide. The consensus figure comes from the separate finviz/Earnings Whispers preview (https://finviz.com/news/421323/atrenews-slower-guide-puts-margins-not-growth-at-center-of-third-quarter-test).

findings.finding: Counterpoint data (2026-10-31) shows iPhone 18 Pro series sales in China up 29% y/y over the first three weeks after the late-September launch, and Apple took about 33% of China weekly sales in launch week while the market fell 17%. Per the 11-11 preview, management had suggested iPhone 18 trade-in timing could be delayed by the staggered launch (base iPhone 18 deferred). Strong Pro sell-through means more high-value iPhone trade-ins into ATRenew's JD/Apple channels at the end of Q3 and through Q4, which supports the Q4 guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock has moved on the next-quarter guide every time it was checked. It fell on a guide below the run-rate in Q1 and Q2 2026, and rose 10.7% on the raised guide in Q3 2025. The guide line moves this stock about 10%.
findings.why_not_priced: The stock has fallen about 12.6% over 30 days and drew two downgrades since this data came out. If the market had translated Apple's China strength into ATRenew's Q4 guide, the 30-day tape would not be negative into the print. It is a proxy: ATRenew has not confirmed its iPhone 18 trade-in volumes.
findings.independence: An earlier Counterpoint launch-week figure (+12% vs the iPhone 17 Pro's first week) appears at https://appleworld.today/2026/09/iphone-sales-in-china-are-up-12-year-over-year-in-the-new-iphone-18-pros-launch-week/, from the same research house. That is not independent of ATRenew's own data, which is absent. The management comment on possible iPhone 18 trade-in delay is from https://finviz.com/news/421323/atrenews-slower-guide-puts-margins-not-growth-at-center-of-third-quarter-test.

findings.finding: China new-smartphone shipments in Q3 2026 hit a 14-year low: IDC -15.4% y/y to 57.9M, Omdia -12% to 59.3M, Counterpoint -10%. IDC blames memory-cost-driven price rises, and Counterpoint expects weaker Q4 demand as higher prices make consumers delay upgrades. Fewer upgrades mean fewer trade-ins, which is the supply side of ATRenew's 1P model and its JD trade-in volume, and that is a risk to the Q4 guide. Higher new-phone prices may also push some demand into used devices, which offsets part of it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Same guide line as above. The stock fell on a guide below the run-rate in Q1 and Q2 2026.
findings.why_not_priced: These are public industry series from mid-October, and the 30-day drawdown and two downgrades suggest they are partly priced. They are filed because ATRenew's Q3 guide (+23-25%) and any Q4 guide were set or will be set against them, and nothing the company has said quantifies the trade-in supply hit.
findings.independence: Omdia's separate count, Q3 2026 -12% with a full-year 2026 forecast of about -7% (https://omdia.tech.informa.com/pr/2026/oct/mainland-china-smartphone-shipments-drop-to-lowest-q3-level-since-2013), points the same way. It is a proxy: ATRenew's own Q2 handled 11.6M products, up from 10.3M, while the new-phone market was already falling.

findings.finding: China's NDRC and Ministry of Finance issued the fourth 2026 tranche of RMB62.5bn in trade-in subsidies around 2026-09-30, completing the full RMB250bn for 2026, with mobile phones and digital products covered and the window open to 2026-12-31. The trade-in channel that feeds ATRenew's JD-linked recycling is funded through Q4, with no gap like the mid-2025 pause.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no clean prior case of a subsidy line in a release. The Q3 2025 print with its raised guide (+10.7%) came during the 2025 subsidy program.
findings.why_not_priced: This is public policy news and mostly priced. It matters only because a funded Q4 removes one reason for management to guide conservatively; a Q4 guide implying a subsidy cliff would contradict it.
findings.independence: The third tranche of RMB62.5bn was issued by 2026-06-30 (https://www.stdaily.com/web/gdxw/2026-06/26/content_537985.html; Xinhua https://www.news.cn/fortune/20260712/ae0c22db97bb4ef293cb5948715aa081/c.html). It comes from the same official source family.

findings.finding: Double 11 2026 total online GMV was estimated at about RMB1.6986tn, +4.64% y/y per 网经社/电数宝, the second-lowest growth in recent years. 星图数据 put first-round comprehensive e-commerce growth at 2.4% against 14.2% the year before. That points to a soft Q4 consumer-electronics backdrop for ATRenew's Q4 guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Same guide line. Stock fell on a soft guide in Q1 and Q2 2026.
findings.why_not_priced: These are broad, public, mid-November figures, so they are mostly priced. They are filed as a small proxy because ATRenew has not spoken since Double 11 and its Q4 guide will be set after it. ATRenew's own Double 11 trade-in data was not found.
findings.independence: A Yicai piece on Double 11 trade-in scenes (https://www.yicai.com/news/103440547.html) carries no recycling volume. The proxy is not confirmed by the company.

findings.finding: Two analysts downgraded ATRenew and none upgraded in the month to 2026-11-17 (AAII, 2026-11-18). The stock is down about 12.6% over 30 days into the print, and the consensus revenue estimate was cut from ~$969M to $944M. The bar into the release has come down.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 came after a run-in and sold off on the guide. There is no clear record of a print after a drawdown on this name.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced by definition, because it is the price. It is filed only because a lowered bar makes an in-line Q4 guide less punishing than in August. The downgrades may themselves carry negative information that is not visible here.
findings.independence: TrendSpider shows -12.64% over 30 days (https://trendspider.com/markets/symbols/RERE/). The consensus cut is in https://finviz.com/news/421323/atrenews-slower-guide-puts-margins-not-growth-at-center-of-third-quarter-test.

findings.finding: The buyback was extended for 12 months from 2026-06-30 with about US$35.2M remaining, roughly 4% of an ~$870M market cap. The company repurchased 1.0M ADSs for $4.2M in Q2 2026, and $14.8M cumulatively since June 2025.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Buybacks were disclosed alongside the Q3 2025 (+10.7%) and Q2 2026 (down) prints. They are not separable from the guide.
findings.why_not_priced: The program is public. A Q3 repurchase pace above Q2's $4.2M, with the stock near its 52-week low, would be new in the release. Small.
findings.independence: The repurchase in Q3 2025 is mentioned at https://simplywall.st/stocks/us/retail/nyse-rere/atrenew/news/atrenew-rere-is-up-107-after-strong-q3-earnings-and-upgraded.

baseline_tension: The baseline is thin, with no options, no skew and no reaction history. The tape is soft into the print (-4.2% over 5 days, -12.6% over 30 days, near the 52-week low, two downgrades), so a small positive lean cuts mildly against the recent tape but not against any option-market statement. Short interest is low, so there is no squeeze mechanism either way.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1 (verified fact is not a reaction; this name sells beats on the guide): the habitual revenue-beat finding cut from +0.5 to +0.2.
Lesson 5 (proxies small): iPhone 18 Pro China sales +1.0 to +0.8, China smartphone shipments -0.8 to -0.6, Double 11 -0.4 to -0.3; all kept and filed as proxies.
Lesson 5 (positioning and analyst-count drawdown worth ~0): downgrades/lowered-bar finding cut from +0.3 to +0.1.

Lesson 8 (understatement): abs_move_pct raised from 9 to 10 on the name's ~10-11% headline reactions; p_up moved from 53 to 52 because the reaction veto (lesson 1) applies to the reported-quarter lean.
